info.name: document-server
info.description:
Standalone Rust/Axum service that renders PDFs from Typst templates and generates standalone 1D barcodes and 2D QR codes. **No authentication** — every route here is open, so there is no Bearer/API-key setup needed.

Base URL (and sample keys) are environment variables — switch the active Postman environment (Development/Production) to point requests at the right instance.

**Modules**:
- `Health`: Liveness probe (`/api/health`).
- `Render`: PDF rendering endpoint (`/api/render/{templateKey}`) with dynamic barcode/QR placeholder support.
- `Templates`: Template metadata listing and retrieval (`/api/templates`), categorized into `document` and `label` with `?type=document|label` filtering.
- `Documents`: Document history and recompilation reprints (`/api/documents/{key}/pdf`).
- `Barcodes`: Standalone 1D barcode generator (`/api/barcodes/generate`) supporting JSON and direct SVG streaming (Code128, Code39, EAN13, EAN8).
- `QRCodes`: Standalone 2D QR code generator (`/api/qrcodes/generate`) supporting JSON and direct SVG streaming (ECC levels L, M, Q, H).

**Getting real template keys**: run `Templates > List Templates` and copy the `key` values into `templateKey` (receipt document) or `stickerKey` (sticker label).

**Getting a real document key**: run `Render > Render Receipt` once, then `Documents > List Documents` and copy a `key` into `documentKey`.

request.description: Liveness check — always returns 200 if the process is up and able to handle a request at all. Doesn't touch SQLite or the render engine, so it can't distinguish "server up, database down".
Trivial "is this module wired up" check — not a health/readiness probe.

Compiles the `receipt` document template against this request body and returns the rendered PDF as raw bytes (`Content-Type: application/pdf`). Supports dynamic barcode or QR code injection via `footerCode` placeholder slot.

Errors return standard `{success, message, code, statusCode}` JSON: 404 `TEMPLATE_NOT_FOUND`, 422 `RENDER_VALIDATION_FAILED`, 500 `PDF_EXPORT_FAILED`.
Compiles the `sticker` label template (50mm×30mm thermal label) with a Code128 barcode and QR code encoding `reference` via `templates/lib/codes.typ`. Returns raw PDF bytes on success.

request.description: Renders the A4 Invoice (the branded/modern layout). `logoUrl` is optional and accepts an http(s) image URL or a `data:image/...;base64,...` URI (jana2u-pos's shop logo is sent this way). The server turns either into a local file for this one compile and discards it; a `data:` logoUrl is also blanked from the recorded documents row. Omit `logoUrl` to use the built-in vector mark. A bad/oversized/non-image URL -> 422 `REMOTE_IMAGE_FETCH_FAILED`. All amounts are integer cents. Resolve `{{templateKey}}` from `GET /api/templates` (description "A4 Invoice").

Renders the multi-section Analytics & Reports PDF. `{{analyticsReportKey}}` is the `templates.key` for the template whose description is "Analytics Report" (GET /api/templates). Payload is built by the jana2u-pos backend's reports::service::report_payload; the worked example here matches the committed sample .json.
Lists template metadata (active and inactive), including category `type` (`document` or `label`), sorted by name. Supports optional `?type=document` or `?type=label` query filter.
Lists only document templates (`templates/documents/`).
Lists only label templates (`templates/labels/`).

Publishes a new template without shell access. The server mints its identity (`doc_temp_<nanoid>` for a document, `lbl_temp_<nanoid>` for a label), writes the `.typ` plus optional `schema`/`sample` sidecars into `templates/documents|labels/`, re-syncs, smoke-compiles against `sample` when given, and hot-swaps the render engine — the template renders on the next request, no restart. Returns the created template (201). On failure the files are rolled back: 422 `TEMPLATE_CREATE_FAILED` (empty source, invalid schema, non-compiling template), 401 without the key.
Fetch one template's metadata by `key` (including `name`, `type`, `description`, `data` expected payload sub-object, `isActive`). 404 `TEMPLATE_NOT_FOUND` if key doesn't exist.

Runtime re-sync without a restart: rescans the templates directory, rebuilds the render engine, upserts metadata for every .typ found (including each template's dataSchema contract), and deactivates templates whose .typ file disappeared (rows are never deleted — keys are stable and history references them). Returns syncedCount, deactivatedCount and the template names now known.
Lists every recorded document (written upon successful render), newest first. Use this to find a real `key` for `{{documentKey}}`.
Fetch one document's metadata by `key` (templateKey, JSON data, and fileSizeBytes). 404 `DOCUMENT_NOT_FOUND` if the key doesn't exist.
Recompiles this document's stored JSON `data` against its template and returns raw PDF bytes (`Content-Type: application/pdf`).

Stores (or replaces) one shared/static JSON blob scoped to a template by name. The template must already exist. At render time every stored blob for that template is deep-merged under the request payload with request fields winning, so callers can omit genuinely static fields. Internal callers only.
Fetches one stored blob by (templateName, dataKey). Internal callers only.

request.description: Lists every stored blob for the template. Internal callers only.
Deletes one stored blob and echoes it back; 404 TEMPLATE_DATA_NOT_FOUND when absent. Internal callers only.
Module status check for the Barcodes service.
Generates a 1D barcode and returns a JSON response containing SVG markup (`{ success: true, data: { content, symbology, svg } }`). Supported symbologies: `code128`, `code39`, `ean13`, `ean8`.
Generates a 1D barcode and streams the raw SVG directly with `Content-Type: image/svg+xml`.
Module status check for the QR Codes service.
Generates a 2D QR code and returns a JSON response containing SVG markup (`{ success: true, data: { content, ecc, svg } }`). Supported ECC levels: `L`, `M`, `Q`, `H`.

query.description: Content or URL to encode in the QR code
Error correction level: L | M | Q | H (default: M)
